The iconoclastic designer appropriates an everyday object and transforms it into an artistic case: the now-famous metal can.The power and freshness of mint and lavender evoke the familiar and comforting scent of shaving soap and is transformed by the sensuality of vanilla. This classic fragrance flouts convention and plays it two ways between tradition and audacity, freshness and softness, strength and sensuality. A truly versatile scent perfect for both casual and formal wear.Top notes: Cardamom, Bergamot, Mint, Lavender, Artemisia.Middle notes: Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Caraway.Base notes: Cedar, Vanilla, Amber, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Boucheron Place Vendôme Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Place Vendôme is a woody, floral fragrance that was launched in 2013. The scent opens with top notes of pink pepper, orange blossom and rose essence. Middle notes are honey, Jasmine and peony. Base notes are benzoin and cedar-wood.

listings.rawTitle: Lanvin Eclat d'Arpege Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Launched in 2003, this sophisticated fragrance has floral top notes and musky base notes that combine to create a joyful, feminine scent. Composed of peony, peach blossom, tea leaf, green lilac, amber, musk, Chinese osmanthus, petit grain, wisteria, and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Presenting a contemporary adaptation of a celebrated classic; Gentlemen Only by Givenchy lifts traditional citrus and aromatic accords, instead focusing on bold and masculine woody essences.A sharp, fresh and spicy gambit applies nutmeg, pink pepper and birch leaf into the citrus nuances of bergamot and mandarin. The heart promises a deep accord set with woody cedar, patchouli and vetiver before a smoky base of musk and incense.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Amour Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Kenzo Amour was launched in 2006. This musky, floral fragrance contains notes of Cherry, Frangipani blossoms, Woods, Incense, Thanaka wood, Rice, White Tea and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Fuel For Life Him Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Diesel Fuel For Life Him Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml is a vibrant men’s fragrance designed for those who enjoy a sense of energy and spontaneity. The scent blends bright grapefruit with aromatic star anise, moving into a heart of smooth lavender and juicy raspberry. It settles into a warm base of heliotrope and dry woods, creating a balance of freshness, subtle sweetness and sensual depth that feels modern yet easy to wear day to day.This fragrance suits men who like a confident, spirited scent that works from daytime through to evening without feeling overpowering. It fits seamlessly into a grooming routine as a finishing touch after showering, shaving or getting ready to go out. The eau de toilette format offers a lighter feel on the skin while still leaving a noticeable trail. Ideal for work, weekends or evenings out, it’s a versatile choice for anyone who wants a fragrance that helps to express personality and adds a polished final step to their routine.Why we love it- Combines bright grapefruit and star anise with lavender, raspberry and warm woods for a lively yet refined scent- Offers a balance of freshness and subtle sweetness that works well from day to night- Sits comfortably on the skin as an eau de toilette, making it easy to wear every day- Fits seamlessly into a grooming routine as a simple final step that adds a polished, confident finishing touchHow to useHow to Use:Apply Diesel Fuel For Life Him Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml to clean, dry skin. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Night For Women Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsession Night For Women Eau de Parfum is a deeper, moodier twist on a classic fragrance, created for evenings when you want to feel confident and quietly seductive. listings.rawTitle: JOOP! Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Joop! Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml is a confident, woody amber fragrance created for those who enjoy a blend of strength and softness.
